messages:
violet: Quick postmortem follow-up for Quartz. Summary: transient VPC peering flap + on-prem KV race caused tenant flows to hit default route. I pulled out concrete actions and owners. Doc: https://docs.redwood.com/postmortems/quartz-2026
infra-bot: Follow-up ticket created: QRT-9001 (quartz-remediate) 1 priority: P2 1 due: 14d
omar: I'll take the peering reconciler fix. Plan: make reconcile idempotent, add route-overlap guard and pre-apply sanity check. Target: PR + staging by Thu. CHG-7007. Blocker: need customer's peering maintenance window confirmation.
jiayi: I'll own the KV/cache race. Repro on onprem-harness at ~10k clients; failing in kv::apply_batch when shard-rebalance interleaves. Estimate 48-72h incl tests. Will post PR: github.com/redwood/runtime/pull/1501 when green.
felix: I'll handle customer comms and mitigation (temporary edge fanout cap + short traffic shaping). Ticket: CUST-14000. Will request firewall/peering windows and propose validation call.
violet: Owners recap: peering -> @omar (CHG-7007 / QRT-9001), kv race -> @jiayi (QRT-9001 / PR pending), comms -> @felix (CUST-14000). Add calendar dates and blockers by EOD.
omar: Customer allowed windows: Wed/Fri 01:00-05:00 JST. Proposing Fri 02:00 JST for CHG. I'll include rollback steps.
jiayi: Starting extended repro now. If stable I'll open PR and schedule staging deploy Tue 09:00 UTC. Adding integration tests for shard alignment.
felix: Draft notice ready, holding for CHG slot. Will send 8h before window and schedule post-change validation call.
violet: Adding monitoring: alert on "tenant_route_fallthrough" > 3/min and "kv_apply_error" spike. Linking alerts to QRT-9001 and adding to the incident trends board.
omar: Adding a controller assertion to refuse apply if peer route ranges overlap unexpectedly. Also adding pre-change dry-run to CHG.
jiayi: Adding regression tests to catch silent model-shard divergence during cache rebuilds.
infra-bot: Linked issues: QRT-9001, CHG-7007, CUST-14000 1 https://tracker.redwood.com/QRT-9001
violet: Proposed timeline: omar change -> Fri 02:00 JST, jiayi staging -> Tue, felix notice -> within 12h of scheduling. If that works I'll close the immediate follow-ups and start a biweekly trends sync. :white_check_mark:
omar: Confirmed CHG-7007 scheduled Fri 02:00 JST, rollback plan included.
jiayi: Staging deploy targeted Tue 09:00 UTC; will post PR when tests pass.
felix: Will send customer notice 8h prior and schedule validation call.
violet: Thanks all 1 I'll run the first trends sync in two weeks; ping me for urgent updates. :thumbsup:
